args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider to separate error toasts into an assertive live region that do not auto-dismiss, while leaving info and success toasts as polite and auto-dismissing.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Toast.tsx places all toasts in a single status container with aria-live="polite" and auto-dismisses every toast after 5000ms. We should update ToastProvider to separate error toasts into an assertive live region that do not auto-dismiss, while leaving info and success toasts as polite and auto-dismissing.
